key_points_missing: Does not correctly identify that GetType().Name returns String (not Object[]) because single-element arrays are unwrapped
key_points_wrong: Suggests the issue is about pipeline casting to System.Object -- the real issue is that PowerShell unwraps single-element arrays, so $x becomes a String, not an array
brief_justification: Misses the key insight: when a function returns an array with one element, PowerShell unwraps it to a scalar. $x.GetType().Name would be 'String', not an array type. The 0-item case is also wrong (returns $null, not empty array).
